clips.title: The story
paras: At Foothold Citadel, Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen directs Theramore's medical care. He trains healers and tests seasoned medics in field triage and bandage work.

On the ground floor of Foothold Citadel, Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen oversees medical care for Lady Jaina Proudmoore's forces and trains Theramore's frontline healers. Dustwallow Marsh makes their work harsh, and VanHowzen demands skill under pressure. He puts experienced medics through a demanding triage test, where they must judge which wounds need care first.
